thread:
sara (Support): hey team — acme-inc is hitting 429s and intermittent 403s since ~03:10 UTC during a demo. latency spiking to ~800ms then full 429 flood. customer says UI upgrade is blocked by a billing hold. urgent: need a short-term burst/bridge so demo doesn't fail tonight. request id: req_0a1b2c

infra-bot: account=acme-inc plan=trial status=billing_hold rate_limit=60req/s burst_tokens=1000min usage_month=3.2Mtokens last_charge_failed=true

tom (Billing): got it. can you share account email or account id? if charge failed we can either clear the hold (needs payment method) or apply a short grace. how long do they need?

sara (Support): account email is dev+acme@acme.com, account id acct_9z7y6x. they need ~3 hours max — it's a live investor demo. customer can't add a card right now (security).

maria (Sales): we can approve a one-time 48h bridge for demo customers if validated. need ARR estimate + name of contact so we can flag for finance. ping me the customer tier privately and i'll start the sales-assisted uplift. :+1:

eli (SRE): quick repro + mitigation steps please. also we can provision a short-term per-account rate bump (temp override) while billing gets sorted. send me a minimal curl that reproduces 429s and a sample error payload (request-id + body) so I can replay. meanwhile enable client exponential backoff (500ms -> 1s -> 2s) and honor Retry-After.

sara (Support): here is the curl they used (redacted token):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/chat/completions \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-prod-REDACTED" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"gpt-4-mini","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"summarize..."}],"max_tokens":512}'
```
error body we got from gateway: `{\"error\":\"rate_limited\",\"code\":429,\"retry_after\":20,\"request_id\":\"req_0a1b2c\"}`

eli (SRE): perfect. i'll replay req_0a1b2c against the infra logs and open a temp override. expected fix timeline: ~10-15m to provision. recommendations for them: add `Retry-After` handler, add jittered backoff, and fall back to a cheaper model for bursts (e.g., gpt-4-mini -> gpt-3.5). sample header we add on our side for clients: `X-Redwood-Temp-Quota: 2h/1000rps` (internal only).

infra-bot: provisioning override: acct_9z7y6x -> +200req/s for 2 hours. ticket=INC-12345.

eli (SRE): done, override active. i'll monitor for regressions and follow up in INC-12345. sara — please confirm customer can continue their demo and collect any additional request-ids if they reoccur. :thumbsup:

sara (Support): confirmed with customer — demo resumed, no 429s in last 7 minutes. sharing contact to sales: john.doe@acme.com, ARR_estimate=~$120k. thanks everyone!
summary: Support thread about acme-inc hitting 429s due to billing hold; team coordinates temporary per-account rate override, repro details, and sales-assisted bridge.
